title: The installed Resolve library (scripts/resolve_library.py scan)
description: v2.45 (2026-10-29). What is installed in DaVinci Resolve on the edit machine — titles, transitions, generators, Fusion / OFX / audio effects — with how a script places each, and a `kinds` map from this skill's kinds to the installed items. Written to <job>/07-edit/resolve-library.json, or <production root>/_studio/resolve-library.json at studio level. Sources: the console's LIBRARY_SCAN (Resolve.GetEffectsList and the template folders), a Templates folder read directly, or the owner's own list. Titles and transitions are not in GetEffectsList. OFX parameters cannot be set by script (21.1.2): an OFX item is `scriptable: defaults-only` and carries `manual`.

resolve.description: Resolve's version string when the console scanned it

name.description: as the Effects Library shows it — the name InsertFusionTitleIntoTimeline and AddTransition take

id.description: the effect id from GetEffectsList — AddEffect(category, id) needs it

pack.description: Krokodove, JTechWP, Video Editor Studio, Free Smooth Transitions, MrAlexTech MagicAnimate, CineDream, Higgsfield, Resolve (built in), Blackmagic, the .drfx or folder name, or unknown

path.description: the template's path under its Templates root (a .drfx member as bundle::member)

published_inputs.description: a Fusion macro's published inputs, read from its .setting: what a script can set through the comp

kinds.description: this skill's kinds the item serves (lower-third, super, hero, end-card · dissolve, whip, push, zoom, light-leak, glitch · animate-in-out, 3d-text, color-match …)

scriptable.description: inputs: published inputs known · comp: a Fusion effect, inputs read through Effect.GetFusionComp() on first use · name: placed by name, nothing to set · defaults-only: OFX, applied with its defaults

manual.description: what a person sets by hand (MagicAnimate's In / Mid / Out, CineDream's look, Color Match's reference)

text_safe.description: present when the name says it overshoots (bounce, elastic, pop): never on text, numbers or UI (house rule C2)

star.description: the owner's pick for its kinds — taken first; kept across re-scans

kinds.description: "<type>/<kind>" → item names, best first: starred, then the grammar's default (Cross Dissolve for a dissolve), then scriptable before manual, then by name

unmapped.description: installed items no kind rule names — look at them, star or note them
